speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: So, all the blocks which are eligible for LUP have already been selected.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: HDB also rolled out a programme in March 2012 to install lifts at all HDB multi-storey car parks without barrier-free accessibility, where it is technically feasible.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Can I query what are the selection criteria for the SLRP?

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: I understand when it was announced in September last year, it was for lifts built between 1987 and 1997, if I remember correctly, and it covered lifts mainly in Pasir Ris.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: And although they do cover some lifts in my ward, they do not cover all the lifts.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: So, can I just query what are the selection criteria?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: So, this is the batch of lifts that were introduced in 1987 to 1997.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: They are the oldest batch of lifts that are not covered under LUP.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: They are located all over Singapore and we are specifically identifying them as that batch of lifts to be replaced because, as I said earlier, these are the lifts which are very old.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: They do not have the features that the newer lifts have, which include energy-efficient motors, vision panels and infra-red motion sensors.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: That is why they were identified for replacement under SLRP.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: I understand that they were the oldest lifts.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: Just to confirm with the Minister – so, for example, I have an estate, Jalan Damai, the estate was built at the same time but I do understand that when HDB purchased these lifts, they purchased different brands and so on and so forth.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: So, in the entire estate, the lifts are largely the same.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: They do not have those vision panels and so forth, but under SLRP, only certain lifts were selected.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: So, it seems a bit incongruous to me that some lifts are selected whereas some lifts are not when the HDB estate was built at the same time.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: And so, that was the clear criterion that was used for the selection.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: The oldest batch of these and we are selecting them for the SLRP.
